learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the interaction of cinema and architecture and the contribution of architectural action to the art of cinema.
Being able to comprehend and discuss the social dimensions of cinematic art and its products.
Gaining the skill of critical and open thinking.
Being able to use film as a different visual and verbal expression tool.
Examining the relationship between time and space through cinema.

syllabus_topics: Interaction of cinema, space, and architecture
Expression of architecture and space as a product in cinema
Space as a film set (Film: Metropolis / 1926 / Lang)
Architecture as a metaphor in cinema / Assignment 1 Presentations and Critiques
Assignment 1 Presentations and Critiques (Film: 24 City / 2008 / Zhangke)
Future architecture and utopia in cinema (Film: Fifth Element /1997 / Besson)
Future architecture and utopia in cinema (Film: Blade Runner / 1982 / Scott)
Architect as a film character (Films: The Lake, House Sitter, Indecent Proposal, White Noise, Simpsons)
Architect as a film character (Films: Sleepless in Seatle, 12 Angry Men, etc.)
Cinema as architectural criticism (Film: Persepolis / 2007 / Paronnaud & Satrapi)
